entities.name: Niqmaddu II
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Niqmaddu II was the second ruler and king of Ugarit, an ancient Syrian city-state in northwestern Syria and succeeding his father, Ammittamru I. He was a vassal ruler of Suppiluliuma I of Hatti.
